notes.title: 1.0.2 Update
notes.content:
[h2][u][b]New Mini-Game "Balldrop"[/b][/u][/h2]

I've added a free new mini-game called "Balldrop". The objective is to keep the ball on the board for as long as possible. There's a leaderboard containing everyone's best time.

[h3][u][b]Bug Fix[/b][/u][/h3]

I've fixed a bug with saving leaderboard times for PoolFrenzy.
